tests.description: tool JSON remains parseable and schema-clean, preserves safe numeric metrics/IDs, masks a secret despite a safe-looking field name, and reports sibling redaction metadata
tests.criterion: AC2 and AC5 structural JSON redaction

tests.description: a secret represented by a required numeric field returns a leak-safe format-unsafe error instead of invalid JSON
thrown tool errors and text resources contain no raw secret and carry sibling redaction state
tests.criterion: AC2 secret absence across error and resource surfaces

tests.description: safe IDs, counts, and decimal metrics survive JSON redaction while real secrets under id/metric field names do not bypass detection
secret URL path/query values are masked while an ordinary public Markdown link does not create an egress finding
tests.criterion: AC5 URL secrecy without classifying content as an operation

test_files.target_module: src/commands/security.ts and recursive scan service implementation

tests.description: a directory recurses by default, follows an internal symlink once, terminates a symlink cycle, scans the canonical file once, and reports complete coverage
tests.criterion: AC6 recursive nested scan and cycle termination

tests.description: external and unreadable entries make required coverage incomplete without exposing the external filename/content or discarding an in-scope secret finding
tests.criterion: AC6 denied/inaccessible coverage and finding retention

tests.description: max-files exhaustion records incomplete coverage while retaining findings from files scanned before the limit
tests.criterion: AC6 bounded traversal and independent findings

notes: All fixtures are synthetic, local, bounded, and removed after each test. No network, provider, model, credential, or private dataset is used. Public MCP contracts are exercised directly. Parent-approved additive output contract: MCP tool/resource results carry sibling redaction:{state,reasons}; operation JSON is never injected with metadata. Proposed pure core seam: validateOutputForTransport({value, format:'json'|'text', schema?}) returns a discriminated {ok,value?,text,redaction}; it walks string leaves independent of field names, preserves safe scalars, and returns format-unsafe rather than changing a secret-bearing numeric value under a sensitive key such as password. Any optional schema check must use only supported project validation and must not claim full JSON Schema. Recursive security scan JSON adds coverage:{status,required,reasons} and files:[{path,status,reason?}], accepts --max-files/--max-bytes, and directories recurse by default. commit_test_stubs=false; no git or flow state was mutated.
